english: The five letters of the word MOTTO are arranged in a row at random, all distinct arrangements being equally likely. Then the probability that no two identical letters are adjacent is ______.
hindi: शब्द MOTTO के पाँच अक्षरों को एक पंक्ति में यादृच्छया व्यवस्थित किया जाता है, सभी भिन्न व्यवस्थाएँ समसम्भाव्य हैं। तब किन्हीं दो सर्वसम अक्षरों के आसन्न न होने की प्रायिकता ______ है।
solution: Total $=\dfrac{5!}{2!\,2!}=30$. Arrange $M,T,T$ first, then put the two O's into different gaps
$TMT$: T's already apart; O's in 2 of the 4 gaps: $\binom{4}{2}=6$
$TTM$ or $MTT$: one O must go between the T's, the other O into one of the other 3 gaps: $3+3=6$
solution_full: MOTTO has $M$ once and $O$, $T$ twice each, so there are $\dfrac{5!}{2!\,2!}=30$ distinct arrangements, all equally likely.
Gap method: first arrange $M,T,T$ (3 distinct orders: $TMT$, $TTM$, $MTT$), then insert the two O's into the 4 gaps, at most one O per gap so that the O's are not adjacent.
Order $TMT$: the T's are separated; any 2 of the 4 gaps work: $\binom{4}{2}=6$ arrangements.

Order $TTM$: the gaps are $\_\,T\,\_\,T\,\_\,M\,\_$. The T's are adjacent unless an O goes into the gap between them, so one O takes that gap and the other O takes one of the remaining 3 gaps: 3 arrangements. Order $MTT$: similarly 3.
Favourable arrangements: $6+3+3=12$. (Inclusion-exclusion check: $30-12-12+6=12$, where $12$ arrangements have $OO$ together, 12 have $TT$ together and 6 have both.)
originality_note: New: a word with two different repeated letters where the gap method must be adapted: when the first repeated letter is adjacent, one copy of the second letter is forced into the gap between them (way 5: gap method and the no-two-alike-adjacent condition linked). Closest known: 'arrangements of PERMUTATION where no two vowels and no two identical letters are adjacent' (the first design, TATTOO, followed that published skeleton and was replaced). Different because: the separation of one pair is achieved by the other pair, so the cases differ.
blueprint_concepts: Arrangements with specified objects separated (gap method)
Arrangements where no two alike objects are adjacent

concept_use.Arrangements with specified objects sepa: The O's are inserted into the gaps of an arrangement of M, T, T, at most one per gap.
concept_use.Arrangements where no two alike objects: No two identical letters adjacent applies to both repeated letters O and T; the TT-adjacent orders need an O between the T's.
